upside.story: P90: ads re-accelerate (2027 ad revenue roughly doubles again once the delayed ad products ship), ad tier in 15 new countries lifts member growth, price rises stick; revenue growth ~13% in 2027-28 and margin ~36% by 2028; the multiple recovers to the peer median plus (~20x).
